messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate for tenant=horizon-health in private/vpc-eu-west-1 — auth failures spiking on control-plane-proxy-*. 503/401 observed. Pager sent to infra-oncall.
ava: acked. Paging now. Can someone grab the runbook for VPC OIDC failures? link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oidc-auth-failures
liam: I'm on it, looking at proxy logs. initial symptom: backend returning 401 "invalid_token: JWT signature verification failed". Seems like JWKS lookup returning 200 but keys don't match.
liam: logs:
```
2026-03-15T10:30:12Z control-plane-proxy-3 auth.go:214 ERROR tenant=horizon-health token_verification failed err="invalid_token: signature expired"
2026-03-15T10:30:13Z control-plane-proxy-2 jwks_cache.go:78 WARN tenant=horizon-health jwks_refresh_status=stale last_fetch=2026-03-14T09:12:01Z
```
cust-horizon-sre: hi all — we rotated keys this morning as part of our scheduled maintenance. We thought it was a seamless rotation. Seeing a sharp increase in 401s starting ~10:28Z. We're getting errors in our app stack too.
ava: thanks. That helps. Likely a rotation + cache mismatch between our proxies and their IdP. Runbook step 1: force-refresh JWKS cache on control-plane-proxies for horizon-health tenant.
liam: I can trigger JWKS refetch via admin API. Command to hit on control-plane leader:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://control-plane.leader.internal/admin/tenants/horizon-health/jwks/refresh
```
liam: doing that now on leader. Also pushing a hash check to verify keys align with their jwks_uri.
devops-bot: job #4587 started: admin.jwks.refresh tenant=horizon-health
devops-bot: job #4587 completed: success
liam: admin refresh returned 200, cache version bumped. Doing a rollouted restart of the proxy on eu-west-1 nodes to clear in-memory caches: `systemctl restart redwood-control-proxy` on proxy-1/2/3 with 30s stagger.
mike: heads-up — careful with restarts during heavy traffic. Are there healthy fallback proxies in other regions we can route to temporarily for horizon-health? We want zero customer impact if possible.
ava: routing policy allows routing to dedicated-fallback pool in us-east-1 but horizon has a VPC restriction; we can't cross-region due to their policy. That means restarts will affect active requests. We'll do one at a time.
tanvi: I'll coordinate with support to set expectation with Horizon SRE and their product teams. Sending a short status message now.
cust-horizon-sre: appreciate it. We can tolerate ~2-5m partial interruption but not extended downtime.
liam: proxy-1 restarted — checks show JWKS now returns matching key thumbprint: `sha256:AB12...` and subsequent requests succeed in logs.
liam: sample success log:
```
2026-03-15T10:37:05Z control-plane-proxy-1 auth.go:110 INFO tenant=horizon-health token_verification ok kid=AB12...
```
ava: monitoring auth success rate. Dashboard shows errors dropping from 65% -> 3% over the last 6 minutes.
oncall-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2 (customer-impacting) — start timeline and notify customer success. Incident channel created: #inc-177800-horizon-oidc
irene: good catch. We should add a longer-term fix: automatic cache invalidation when IdP emits `kid` changes or when the jwks_uri returns different key ids. For now, document the manual refresh runbook step.
mike: I'll own a short postmortem action: a) add proactive jwks TTL monitoring b) add a safe-rolling refresh command that respects VPC routing constraints c) pre-authorized fallback key mechanism for emergency rotations.
ava: handoff: I need to go for lunch in 25m — mike, can you take on-call lead for the next 2 hours? I'll leave a quick status update in the ticket.
mike: taking lead. Summary for handoff: root cause — Horizon rotated OIDC key pair; our proxies cached JWKS and didn't pick up new kid quickly; manual admin refresh + staggered proxy restarts restored auth. Impact — authenticated requests failed for horizon-health's VPC only; no other customers affected. Mitigation — JWKS admin refresh, proxy restarts. Duration ~10m.
ava: leaving: added runbook steps to the incident ticket: https://redwood.internal/incidents/177800
cust-horizon-sre: thanks everyone — we've pinned a notification to our ops channel. We'll schedule coordinated rotations next time and announce to Redwood before rotation window.
liam: follow-up: capture exact times and which proxy nodes were restarted. attaching list: proxy-1 (10:35Z), proxy-2 (10:38Z), proxy-3 (10:40Z). Postmortem items assigned.
tonvi: (support) sending update to customer success & account exec, do not escalate to execs yet; message: "we resolved auth failures for Horizon Health — temporary auth errors during key rotation; working on safeguards to prevent recurrence." :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Handoff complete — new oncall lead: mike. Incident moved to monitoring state.
mike: next steps owners:
- liam: short PR to make jwks admin refresh idempotent and add verification (due EOD)
- irene: add jwks TTL/rotation alert to infra-dash (due 2 days)
- ava: update private runbook with explicit VPC constraints and restart guidance (due EOD)
- devops-bot: create playbook run for automated staggered restarts (queued)

ava: thanks team. I'll re-open if anything spikes back up. Closing channel for now. :white_check_mark:
